newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela Fogade to sell 2 seats on Caracas bolsa.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela Fogade to sell 2 seats on Caracas bolsa.

text.p: Venezuelan state deposits guarantee fund Fogade will auction two seats on the Caracas stock exchange on September 26 for a base price of 76.5 million bolivars ($165,000) each, Fogade said.
"The two seats are numbers 12, which belongs to Banguaira Brokers, and number 33, which belongs to J.D.Cordero and Associates Brokers," Fogade said in a press release.
Interested bidders must register before September 24 and place a deposit equal to 10 percent of the base price, Fogade added.
